page.layout: One printed page: title page. Top: title in large capitals, centred (4 lines of heading, then a line "SCRIPTUM:"). Below: a list of three numbered items in italic, with hanging indents. Centre: a woodcut emblem with a motto ring (no text to transcribe apart from the ring motto). Bottom: imprint in italic and capitals, with a rule and date line.

main_text.l: I. Falconis complementum, in quo de Metonymia Sacramentali, de rei signatæ perceptione, de manducatione infidelium disputatur.
III. Index aliquot grauissimorum certaminum & errorum Iacobi Andreæ è postremis eius centonibus collectorum.

page.notes: Woodcut emblem between the list and the imprint, with the ring motto "SERVATA FIDES" / "MATTHÆS HARNISCH" / "DITAT" (ring text partly legible; the ring reads around an oval with clasped hands). Handwritten marks "2" and "1" at top and top right are not transcribed. The imprint's first word is set with a decorative initial N, transcribed as NEOSTADII. Doubtful: "Vbiquitarij" and "Matthaei" are read from the scan with reasonable confidence.
